messages.subject: Backtransform
parts:
Hello Unmarked group,
I have a question concerning the backtranform function. I have a final N-mixture model output of ‘pcount’ - I placed them below. All data are stacked/stretched across multiple years running 2010-2018. Overall, I have 35379 rows for each variable.

My question is how can I back-transform from link scale to original scale for each covariate and obtain their SE in both ‘p’ and ’N’ models.

I tried to make a data.frame for the covariates included in ’N’ and 'p':

newdat <- data.frame(np = seq(0.0,400,,35379),
wr = seq(0.0,400,,35379), pa = seq(0.0,400,,35379),
nha=seq(0.0,400,,35379), el = seq(-25,3245,,35379), rd = seq(0.0,3092,,35379))
predict(fm23, type=‘state',newdata=newdat, append=T)
linearComb(fm23, type="state", newdata=newdat)

Do not know how to add ‘years’ in the data frame and whether the minimum and maximum values plus number of rows that I specified above are correct?
I much appreciate if anyone could give me advice to understand this and how to properly get these transformation out?.

Thanks already!

Regards
Mahmood

Call:
pcount(formula = ~ue + ug + rs ~ -1 + np + pa + nha + wr + el +
rd + yr, data = umf, mixture = "NB", starts = starts, se = T,
control = list(trace = T, REPORT = 5))

Abundance:

pa 0.0927 0.0328 2.823 4.76e-03 # protected area

wr -0.0203 0.0389 -0.521 6.02e-01 # wildlife refuge
el 0.0195 0.0413 0.473 6.36e-01 # elevation
rd 0.3630 0.0388 9.353 8.52e-21 # road
yr2010 -4.1855 0.5276 -7.933 2.14e-15
yr2011 -3.5356 0.3729 -9.482 2.48e-21
yr2012 -2.7812 0.2783 -9.993 1.64e-23
yr2013 -1.1608 0.1850 -6.275 3.50e-10
yr2014 -0.7795 0.1807 -4.314 1.60e-05
yr2015 -0.8814 0.1737 -5.073 3.91e-07
yr2016 -1.0848 0.1779 -6.099 1.07e-09
yr2017 -1.0562 0.1761 -5.999 1.99e-09
yr2018 -1.0882 0.1897 -5.737 9.65e-09

Detection:

ue 1.317 0.4865 2.71 6.78e-03 # jobless index (9-yr)
